verdict.rationale: Flagright is API-first. It documents a REST API covering both FRAML and Management operations, official Python and Node/TypeScript clients, and dedicated sandbox servers. Rules, cases and alerts can be created and updated idempotently by API, so the product can be driven headlessly by automation. However, there is no CLI, no CI pipeline integration and no documented headless or CI workflow, so CI use is only implied by the API surface. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/CD usage or examples, API-key/automation auth guidance for pipelines, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Flagright API is organized around REST.
Flagright maintains official API clients for Python and Node/Typescript.
Created rule instances can be idempotently updated with the `POST /rule-instances/{ruleInstanceId}`.
